title: Capture private Tuya identity publication custody
objective: Close credential-bearing private identity publication races while preserving admitted-root authority, exact writer digest fencing, secure cleanup, and package/field contracts before composition.

blockers.reason: Legacy publication-custody repair PR #2755 remains actively owned at exact 4f4249ab729e587a347a93f84e66917ccafc391f. Capture Private Identity Publication Races, Field Build Provenance, and Main Selective Graft are red and Xcode is skipped; do not duplicate production edits on this active branch. Exact current source/review confirms two publication invariants are still open together: same-inode same-size staging payload mutation is accepted because final validation binds dev/ino/link/size but never final bytes to the intended payload (#2767), and a post-publication validation failure can leave substituted attacker bytes at the credential-bearing final path because cleanup only unlinks the now-absent temporary name. The final writer repair must bind final descriptor bytes with stable metadata around the read, clean/reject contaminated final state safely, then update the privileged shell writer SHA and package custody contract only after writer bytes settle. Field acceptance also retains the macOS self-test portability blocker where trusted temporary `/var` ancestry can traverse a platform symlink; fix the trusted self-test path without weakening production no-symlink root custody.

Production shell on #2755 already has the correct security order: checkout FD 9 is admitted before `/bin/cat` captures writer bytes, writer digest is fenced, then hidden credentials are read. But its current `TuyaPrivateIdentityCheckoutRootCustodySourceTests.swift` only proves root admission and digest fence each precede credentials; it does NOT prove root admission precedes writer-byte capture. Review child #2733 exact 55d33a1be7b6e4ce692e316e61ee7bfa33d07376 carries the unique source-contract assertion `root admission -> writer byte capture -> digest fence -> credentials`. Preserve/absorb that regression into the final #2755 successor so later refactors cannot reopen the checkout-replacement interval while still satisfying the weaker before-credentials test.

Final accepted successor must preserve admitted-root and Darwin secure-publication semantics, close both publication byte/cleanup invariants, update exact writer digest/package contract after bytes stabilize, absorb #2733 ordering regression, and rerun publication/Field/Graft/Xcode on one unchanged head.
